Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the product looks promising for our ingestion and clinical search use cases. Our execs want a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align finances and engineering before the June board review. Key asks from our side:

- Org creation on Redwood console with a 30-day eval policy
- API keys scoped to test environment (read-only + generation)
- IP allowlist for our ingestion runners (we'll share CIDR blocks)
- Optional VPC peering to route model calls into our private subnet for PHI testing

Target timeline: start the POC week of May 31, go/no-go by June 10. Can your team commit to those milestones?

I've included our procurement contact on this thread for initial terms.

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely align to a short MAP and the June 10 go/no-go target. High-level plan below (I attached a one-page MAP worksheet):

1) Org & access (May 26–28)
   - Create Healthlytics org in Redwood console
   - Create two API key scopes: "hl-POC-admin" (team-only) and "hl-POC-app" (ingestion/test)
   - Default token TTL set to 24h for test keys; we can extend if needed

2) Network gating (May 28–31)
   - Provide IP allowlist CIDR blocks; we'll add to the eval org's firewall
   - If you opt for VPC peering: schedule peering window and exchange routing tables. Peering steps are in the attached checklist.

3) Technical kickoff (May 31)
   - 60-minute session: engineers + SREs to validate peering, keys, and a small sample request.

4) Stability & performance checks (Jun 1–8)
   - Run 3 load pulses (short bursts) and a latency sweep; we'll share token-level costs.

5) Go/no-go and procurement (Jun 9–10)
   - If green, procurement loops in for terms and we execute the pilot contract.

Next steps: I'll share a MAP worksheet and a network-peering checklist in a follow-up email. Karthik — can you coordinate the tech kickoff slot for May 31? Laura, I'll need a quick review on the key TTL policy.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
